notes.title: KINGDOM of the DEAD is a Gold Winner for NYX Games Awards!
notes.content:
Greetings Gatekeepers! 

Today, we are proud to share with you all a new goal we achieved: KINGDOM of the DEAD won two Gold awards for the PC Game: Indie and shooting category! 

The NYX Games Awards is an international competition that recognizes creativity and technical excellence in the Gaming Industry, and we had the chance to show our game to a talented jury made up of passionate industry veterans. 

With this message, we’d love to take the opportunity to kindly thank the jury of the NYX Games Awards and to thank all of you for keep supporting us and have fun! 

Now, grab your shotgun and venture into the abyss once again! 

- Alessandro from HOOK

notes.title: KINGDOM of the DEAD is coming!
notes.content:
East Coast, North America, 19th Century. 
Agent Chamberlain, a professor turned Army General, now works for a secret government program known as GATEKEEPER. Their primary purpose is to defeat the newly empowered Death and his ever-growing army of the dead.

Are you ready to brave the darkness and remind Death where it belongs?

After months of development we are excited to announce that our KINGDOM of the DEAD - an action packed horror themed First Person Shooter - is coming to PC via Steam this winter!

KINGDOM of the DEAD blends old school FPS action with unique black and white pen and ink style visuals to create a terrifying gameplay world where players wage war in a deadly battle against Death’s ever growing army.

In KOTD you’ll be able to experience:

Classic FPS gameplay with different objectives at each difficulty level.
Hunt the undead hordes across multiple remote locations along the US East Coast.
Equip 8 weapons and go toe to toe with over 22 undead enemies and face old school bosses.
Switch up your gameplay experience with a customizable colour palette and cheat code access. 
Test your mettle and face off against a never-ending onslaught in the endless gameplay mode.

We can't wait to share more with you about the game, so join the conversation on our social media on Twitter and Reddit             

Don't forget to add KINGDOM of the DEAD to your wishlist to stay up to date!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547380/KINGDOM_of_the_DEAD/

See you in the dark,

KOTD Team
